title: Kitchri
subtitle: rice and red lentils with garlic
description: An Iraqi rice and red lentil dish cooked in a spiced tomato base and finished with fried garlic and cumin.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a pot and fry the chopped onion until golden.
Add the tomato paste and season with salt, turmeric, black pepper and sweet paprika. Mix well until the spices bloom in the oil.
Add the boiling water and bring back to the boil. Meanwhile rinse the lentils and rice well and drain.
When the water is boiling, add the rice and lentils to the pot, stir, cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes (placing baking paper under the lid helps seal it, but is optional).
Open the pot, gently stir with a fork, cover again and cook on low heat for another 10 minutes.
About 5 minutes before the end of cooking, heat a little oil in a small pan and fry the cumin and garlic until golden (careful not to burn the garlic).
Pour the garlic mixture over the rice, mix well, turn off the heat and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
